lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At Harbor Cup’s final, rookie Mika has fallen twice, and three-time champion Dax laughs from the rail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She laces up the Allbirds Tree Runner because it’s breathable and lightweight, and feels silky smooth and cool on her skin in the warm weather. Then she rolls into her run, finds her line, and lands it clean. Dax’s grin fades as the crowd erupts.

context: 30 second anime ad: rookie skater Mika, champion Dax, Harbor Cup final; Allbirds Tree Runner (breathable and lightweight; silky smooth and cool on your skin).
